listing.name: Starsector Multiplayer (SSMP)
listing.summary: If you are ready to begin actual star sector multiplayer, Indepent fleets and players, a completely synchronized campaign, Coop battles, Trading, Piracy, and faction warfare then pay attention.

description:
If you are ready to begin actual star sector multiplayer, Indepent fleets and players, a completely synchronized campaign, Coop battles, Trading, Piracy, and faction warfare then pay attention.

Each player runs their own independent game and the mod will automatically connect you through encrypted IROH Networking, no more are the days of hamachi and port forwarding. Drag and drop the latest mod, send your buddies your code, and load in

Features include (Not limited to)
Multiplayer campaign with up to 4 players (10+ to come soon)

Independent fleets, missions, trading, exploration, and combat.

Join ongoing battles after your friend is screaming in your ear for help for 3 min, combat syncs up mid fight it doesnt require to join at the same time

Shared optional tutorial, galaxy, and campaign progression.

PvP piracy, inventory theft, and faction pvp warfare coming soon



Current status: Early Playtest

Everything is now working, we have been on this project for 3-4 months now and we are ready to open up to public testing. There is still occasional rubber banding, sync delays, packetloss etc... but updates will improve and hotfix time will be quicker once this opens.

Many future plans to come but lets get this game working with multiplayer finally.


Forumn link: Link will be published shortly.

GitHub: https://github.com/blazingblazed1/Star-Sector-Multiplayer---SSMP-/releases/tag/SSMP
